name: What is the process for making my existing website AI-Ready?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for making my existing website AI-Ready?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a comprehensive audit of your current website's structure, performance, and data architecture. This is followed by strategic planning to identify key AI integration points and desired functionalities. Implementation involves optimizing website code, integrating necessary APIs, structuring data for AI consumption, and setting up AI tools. Finally, continuous monitoring and refinement ensure the AI systems perform optimally and adapt to new data.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an audit, strategic planning, code optimization, API integration, data structuring, AI tool setup, and continuous monitoring.
